```python
from typing import List


def filter_by_prefix(strings: List[str], prefix: str) -> List[str]:
    
    return [x for x in strings if x.startswith(prefix)]



# Unit test for function filter_by_prefix
def test_filter_by_prefix():
    # Test with empty list
    assert filter_by_prefix([], "a") == []

    # Test with empty prefix (should return all strings)
    assert filter_by_prefix(["abc", "def", "ghi"], "") == ["abc", "def", "ghi"]

    # Test with prefix matching some strings
    assert filter_by_prefix(["abc", "bcd", "cde", "array"], "a") == ["abc", "array"]

    # Test with prefix matching no strings
    assert filter_by_prefix(["abc", "bcd", "cde"], "z") == []

    # Test with prefix matching all strings
    assert filter_by_prefix(["abc", "abcd", "abcde"], "abc") == ["abc", "abcd", "abcde"]

    # Test case sensitivity
    assert filter_by_prefix(["Apple", "apple", "APple"], "ap") == ["apple"]

    # Test with single character prefix
    assert filter_by_prefix(["cat", "dog", "cow"], "c") == ["cat", "cow"]

    # Test with longer prefix than some strings
    assert filter_by_prefix(["ab", "abc"], "abc") == ["abc"]

    # Test that order is preserved
    result = filter_by_prefix(["axe", "bat", "ant", "bee"], "a")
    assert result == ["axe", "ant"]

    # Test with duplicate strings
    assert filter_by_prefix(["foo", "foo", "bar"], "foo") == ["foo", "foo"]

    # Test with prefix equal to full string
    assert filter_by_prefix(["hello", "world"], "hello") == ["hello"]

    # Test with special characters
    assert filter_by_prefix(["#tag", "tag", "#comment"], "#") == ["#tag", "#comment"]

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_filter_by_prefix()
```
